text.hi: किताब: संकेतों की मदद से अर्जुन के बारे में छह वाक्य लिखो: a Pandav prince, very good archer, elder to, younger than, son of। उदाहरण: Arjun was a Pandav prince.
text.hinglish: Kitaab: sanketon ki madad se Arjun ke baare mein chhah vaakya likho: a Pandav prince, very good archer, elder to, younger than, son of. Udaharan: Arjun was a Pandav prince.
text.en: The book: write six sentences about Arjun with the clues: a Pandav prince, very good archer, elder to, younger than, son of. Example: Arjun was a Pandav prince.

steps.answer: He was a very good archer.

prompt.en: Clue: younger than Yudhisthir and Bhim

steps.answer: He was younger than Yudhisthir and Bhim.

meaning.hi: वे युधिष्ठिर और भीम से छोटे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh Yudhishthir aur Bheem se chhote the.

prompt.en: Clue: elder to Nakul and Sahadev

steps.answer: He was elder to Nakul and Sahadev.

meaning.hi: वे नकुल और सहदेव से बड़े थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh Nakul aur Sahadev se bade the.

prompt.en: Clue: son of Pandu and Kunti

steps.answer: He was the son of Pandu and Kunti.

meaning.hi: वे पांडु और कुंती के पुत्र थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh Pandu aur Kunti ke putra the.

steps.answer: He was Guru Dron's favourite student.

meaning.hi: वे गुरु द्रोण के सबसे प्रिय शिष्य थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh Guru Dron ke sabse priya shishya the.
